_comment: Fake ads for the broadcast layout. Edit this file between shows; the
overlay picks up changes on its next poll, no restart needed.
Each slot needs a headline. Everything else is optional:
body    one line under the headline
tag     small text in the corner, e.g. who made it
accent  hex colour for the rule and the tag
image   filename inside config/ads/ — if set, the image fills the
weight  how often this slot comes up, default 1
Keep at least one Discord promo in rotation.

slots.headline: Join the Discord
slots.body: Place your bets, argue about Peach, get pinged when we go live.
slots.tag: the only real link on this board

slots.headline: Bowser Bros. Demolition
slots.body: Your castle, our problem. Forty years of unsolicited renovation.

slots.headline: Toad's Discount Mushrooms
slots.body: One size. No refunds. Ask about the green ones.

slots.headline: Want your ad here?
slots.body: Make one and post it in #fake-ads. We will run it.
